headline: Migros supermarkets and the defense industry. Anadolu Group announced its plans in Uzbekistan
summary: Turkey's Anadolu Group is considering new projects in Uzbekistan with Migros supermarkets in retail and agriculture. It also plans to expand car manufacturing and develop defence industry cooperation.
why: Anadolu Group is a large Turkish conglomerate with interests in retail, automotive and defence, so its overseas expansion signals foreign investment flows into the target market.
original_headline: Migros supermarketlari va mudofaa sanoati. Anadolu Group O‘zbekistondagi rejalari haqida ma’lum qildi
